title: Shards of Alara: card flavor text

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane that shattered centuries ago into five shards, each with its own magic and ways of life.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: The shard of angels and knights with a strict caste and sigil system of loyalty, honor and truth.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The shard of etherium, sphinxes, vedalken and mechanists, with twenty-three named winds.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The shard of undeath, necromancer barons and demons where death and decay abound.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The shard of dragons, goblins and viashino with deadly landscapes and sangrite.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The jungle shard of elves, nacatl and gargantuans, where the hydra-god Progenitus is said to sleep.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A Bant defender who praises those who put loyalty above glory.

entities.name: Rafiq of the Many
entities.description: A Bant knight and leader who bears many sigils and speaks of never being alone in combat.

entities.name: Knight-Captain Wyhorn
entities.description: A Bant knight-captain who advises how to counter aven bandits.

entities.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
entities.description: The sphinx ruler of Esper who demands an unheard riddle for an audience and dreams of a polished world.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer whose curiosity for buried secrets deepened as truth was revealed; he views Esper as art.

entities.name: Sedris, the Traitor King
entities.description: A Grixis king who bids minions rise from their graves.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: A Jund leader who comments on Jund's wounds, ancient thrashes, lightning and necrogenesis.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-revering planeswalker who praises dragons as power married to will.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin who speaks of retribution by claws and rage.

entities.name: Mayael the Anima
entities.description: The sacred Anima of Naya, whose eyes are blind to all but the grandest truths.

entities.name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
entities.description: A Jund warrior whose twenty-two braids are bound with bone and leather from foes.

entities.name: Ennor
entities.description: A vedalken mentalist who treats thoughts as commodities.

entities.name: Lodus of the Ethersworn
entities.description: An Ethersworn zealot who argues all life must be touched by etherium.

entities.name: Xorin
entities.description: An Architect of Will who commands a creature to do what he tells it.

entities.name: Cinna
entities.description: A vedalken consul who prefers tools of certainty to speculation.

entities.name: Dolomarus
entities.description: A proctor who finds a dispeller's capsule pleasing.

entities.name: Syeena
entities.description: An elvish godtoucher who prays for gargantuans.

entities.name: Rannon
entities.description: A Vithian holdout who fights necromancers with ingenuity.

entities.name: Shungus Nod
entities.description: A fleshcrafter whose last notes describe digging up extinct Grixis remains.

entities.name: Indra
entities.description: A nullmage of Vectis who scorns an amateur's work.

entities.name: Eliza of the Keep
entities.description: A Grixis figure choosing loathing, hate or malice for the day.

entities.name: Tullus of Palandius
entities.description: A scholar who prefers own knowledge over dogma.

entities.name: Olcot
entities.description: A rider who warns of the ruins of Sedraxis.

entities.name: Quennus
entities.description: A metallurgeon who holds that no scrap metal is beyond repair.

entities.name: Urak
entities.description: A man killed after freezing at the sound of a manaplasm.

entities.name: Tameron
entities.description: A sphinx who gave a marble chalice hoping drinkers would live long enough to decrypt sphinx wisdom.

entities.name: Gorael
entities.description: A sphinx who gave an onyx goblet hoping humans and vedalken would destroy each other.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A hydra-god believed to sleep beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

entities.name: Order of the Skyward Eye
entities.description: A Bant order that unwittingly does the bidding of an evil force, stirring fear and mistrust.

entities.name: Order of the White Orchid
entities.description: A Bant order that confers sigils on knights-captain.

entities.name: Ethersworn
entities.description: The zealots who govern Esper and seek to infuse all life with etherium.

entities.name: Architects of Will
entities.description: Esper agents who mark victims whose secrets are no longer secret.

entities.name: Sanctum Arcanum
entities.description: Scholars who have pondered every word of the Filigree Texts.

entities.name: Filigree Texts
entities.description: Sacred texts of Esper whose precepts specify consequences.

entities.name: Rip Clan
entities.description: Warriors of Jund who wear beetle-acid scars with pride.

entities.name: Split-Eye Coven
entities.description: Grixis witches who harvest vis from the living.

entities.name: Jhess
entities.description: An island nation of Esper under siege from Valeron.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: A mainland land of Bant with elite cavalry and the Sun-Dappled Court.

events.summary: Rafiq says even in single combat he is never alone.
events.quote: Even in single combat, I am never alone.

events.summary: Elspeth credits Akrasa's safety to those who put loyalty above glory.
events.quote: Only by the bravery of those who put loyalty above glory is our home kept safe.

events.summary: Wyhorn advises filling the sky with boulders against aven bandits.
events.quote: Aven bandits can be sly.

events.summary: Sharuum dreams of sleeping to wake to a polished vision.
events.quote: Soon I will sleep, eyes closing to a world tarnished with flesh, and then wake to a polished vision.

events.summary: Lodus declares all life from tower to sea must be touched by etherium.
events.quote: From the highest towers to the deepest sea, all life must be touched by etherium.

events.summary: Rogue mechanists build unauthorized golems to threaten the sphinxes' hegemony; mindlock orbs stop them.
events.quote: Rogue mechanists once rummaged through the wastes of the Tidehollow

events.summary: Xorin says his creature is free because he has told it what to do.
events.quote: It's free to do whatever it wants.

events.summary: The Order of the Skyward Eye unwittingly stirs fear and mistrust across Bant for an evil force.
events.quote: The Order of the Skyward Eye does the bidding of an evil force, unwittingly stirring fear and mistrust across Bant in accordance with his plans.

events.summary: An archdemon's necropolis at Unx was once a living city.
events.quote: The necropolis at Unx was once a living city, its streets untrodden by death.

events.summary: Shungus Nod's last notes record unearthing a chamber of extinct Grixis species.
events.quote: On our thirty-fourth day of digging, we unearthed a chamber

events.summary: Sedris says the future is a snake devouring life backward.
events.quote: The future is a snake, devouring your life backwards through time.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol praises the dragon as a marriage of power and will.
events.quote: The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it.

events.summary: Rakka Mar warns Jund is a wounded world whose searing blood spills out.
events.quote: Jund is a wounded world.

events.summary: Rakka Mar warns of ancient thrashes lingering in shadow.
events.quote: Thrashes of the ancient past still linger in spirit and shadow

events.summary: Old dying dragons throw themselves into volcanoes, causing disaster.
events.quote: Old, dying dragons throw themselves into volcanoes, causing massive upheaval and widespread disaster.

events.summary: Mayael says the reckoning of the mighty is neither subtle nor cryptic.
events.quote: Never subtle nor cryptic is the reckoning of the mighty.

events.summary: Urak freezes on hearing a manaplasm and dies after casting a ward.
events.quote: Urak froze when he heard it.

events.summary: A keeper watches the valley where Progenitus sleeps.
events.quote: He watches over the valley where Progenitus sleeps

events.summary: Elves believe Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.
events.quote: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

events.summary: Revealing the truth only deepens Tezzeret's curiosity for the secrets still buried.
events.quote: Revealing the truth only deepened Tezzeret's curiosity for the secrets still buried.

events.summary: Frozen goblins are eaten by a dragon's diving mate.
events.quote: Frozen in fear, the goblins stared upward at the circling hunter

events.summary: Ennor tells a victim thoughts are commodities.
events.quote: Thoughts are commodities.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol calls the dragon hunger, heat and need without pretense.
events.quote: The dragon has no pretense of compassion, no false mask of civilization

events.summary: Akrasa holds a yearly joust whose prize is an Akrasan sigil.
events.quote: Once a year, Akrasa holds a joust that draws knights and their leotaus from every nation on Bant.

events.summary: The Order of the White Orchid confers its sigil on a knight-captain.
events.quote: Rise, knight-captain, and do your duty.

events.summary: Ajani says retribution is best delivered by claws and rage.
events.quote: Retribution is best delivered by claws and rage, with both magnified.

events.summary: Tezzeret says Esper can be appreciated only from a distance.
events.quote: Esper, like any work of art, can be truly appreciated only from a distance.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol declares destruction a language everyone understands.
events.quote: Destruction is a language everyone understands.

events.summary: Olcot warns that the ruins of Sedraxis, once a shining capital in Vithia, are a blight.
events.quote: They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia.

events.summary: The obelisks of the shards have long faithfully served forgotten purposes since the plane shattered.
events.quote: Centuries have passed since the plane shattered

relations.note: She speaks for protecting Bant's home.
relations.quote: Only by the bravery of those who put loyalty above glory is our home kept safe.

relations.note: She is the hegemon whose audience needs an unheard riddle.
relations.quote: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

relations.note: Sacred Anima whose druids roam Naya.
relations.quote: Although the Anima herself remains at the Sacellum, her druids roam Naya
